import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    cnt=Counter(v for g2 in g for v in g2); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    nz=[(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c] not in (bg,0)]
    rs=[r for r,c in nz]; cs=[c for r,c in nz]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pat=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    pat=[row[::-1] for row in pat]  # horizontal flip
    zs=[(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]==0]
    R0=min(r for r,c in zs); R1=max(r for r,c in zs)
    C0=min(c for r,c in zs); C1=max(c for r,c in zs)
    H,W=len(pat),len(pat[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(R0,R0+H):
        for c in range(C0,C0+W):
            out[r][c]=pat[r-R0][c-C0]
    return out
print(f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
res=f(G['Test input'])
for r in res: print(' '.join(map(str,r)))
print(json.dumps(res))
